title: Crop production for observatory products
source: FAO. 2025. FAOSTAT: Crops and livestock products.
license: CC BY 4.0, subject to the FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use. Not an FAO endorsement.
note: Production (t), area harvested (ha), and yield (kg/ha) for 2015–2024. Tea is fresh leaves, not made tea. Rice is the FAO rice item, not milled-rice trade. Palm fruit and palm oil are separate and must not be added. Cotton lint has no harvested-area series in this extract. Pepper is Piper, not Capsicum. Natural rubber is item 836, not HS 4001 trade and not the TSR20 price. Groundnuts are item 242, in shell, not HS 1202 trade and not the Pink Sheet groundnut or groundnut-oil price. Maize is item 56, grain, not HS 1005 customs weight and not the US Gulf No. 2 yellow price. Tobacco is item 826, unmanufactured, not HS 2401 customs weight and not the US import unit value. Sugar cane is item 156 and sugar beet is item 157; do not add them. Raw centrifugal sugar is item 162, not cane or beet tonnage, not HS 1701 customs weight, and not the ISA world price. Raw sugar has production only. A missing country-year is not zero production. Macao has no rows for these items.

items.name: Coffee, green
items.detail: Green coffee. Not roasted coffee and not export supply.

items.name: Tea leaves
items.detail: Fresh tea leaves. Not made tea, not the Mombasa auction price, and not export weight.

items.name: Rice
items.detail: FAO rice item. Not milled-rice trade under HS 1006.

items.name: Wheat
items.detail: FAO wheat. Not HS 1001 trade.

items.name: Cocoa beans
items.detail: Cocoa beans. Not liquor, butter, or export shipments.

items.name: Cashew nuts, in shell
items.detail: In-shell cashew. Not shelled nuts under HS 080132.

items.name: Oil palm fruit
items.detail: Fresh fruit bunches. Do not add this to palm oil production.

items.name: Palm oil
items.detail: Processed palm oil. Separate from oil-palm fruit.

items.name: Cotton lint
items.detail: Ginned lint. Closer to raw cotton trade than seed cotton.

items.name: Oranges
items.detail: Orange production. Not HS 080510 exports.

items.name: Tomatoes
items.detail: Tomato production. Not HS 0702 exports.

items.name: Sesame seed
items.detail: Sesame seed. Not HS 120740 exports.

items.name: Pepper (piper spp.)
items.detail: Piper pepper. Not Capsicum, and not HS 090411 or 090412 exports.

items.name: Vanilla
items.detail: Vanilla beans. Not HS 0905 exports.

items.name: Cloves
items.detail: Cloves. Not HS 0907 exports.

items.name: Natural rubber
items.detail: Natural rubber production. Not HS 4001 export weight and not the TSR20 benchmark.

items.name: Groundnuts, excluding shelled
items.detail: In-shell groundnuts. Not shelled nuts, not HS 1202 export weight, and not the Pink Sheet groundnut or groundnut-oil price.

items.name: Maize (corn)
items.detail: FAO maize grain. Not HS 1005 customs weight, not seed trade alone, and not the US Gulf No. 2 yellow benchmark.

items.name: Unmanufactured tobacco
items.detail: Unmanufactured tobacco. Not manufactured tobacco, not HS 2401 customs weight, and not the US import unit value.

items.name: Sugar cane
items.detail: Sugar cane. Not sugar beet, not raw or refined sugar, not HS 1701 customs weight, and not the ISA world price.

items.name: Sugar beet
items.detail: Sugar beet. Not sugar cane. Do not add beet to cane. Not HS 1701 customs weight and not the ISA world price.

items.name: Raw cane or beet sugar (centrifugal only)
items.detail: Raw centrifugal sugar from cane or beet. Not refined sugar, not sugar-cane or sugar-beet tonnage, not HS 1701 customs weight, and not the ISA world price.
